thesis: Web governance and technical crawler controls are formalizing rapidly across standards bodies, infrastructure edge implementations, search platform policies, and European regulatory frameworks.

executive_shifts.headline: Cryptographic Bot Authentication Advances in Standards and Edge Performance
executive_shifts.summary: The IETF Web Bot Auth Working Group formally adopted the draft-ietf-webbotauth-httpsig-protocol-00 specification for signing automated requests, while Cloudflare improved its reference implementation with Ed25519 key caching to lower verification overhead by roughly 10 percent.

executive_shifts.headline: Apple Partitioned AI Crawler Controls from Organic Search Rankings
executive_shifts.summary: Apple updated documentation to confirm that disallowing the Applebot-Extended AI training crawler via robots.txt will not impact website rankings in Spotlight, Siri, or Safari search results.

executive_shifts.headline: European Commission Expanded DSA Classifications to ChatGPT, Reddit, and Roblox
executive_shifts.summary: The European Commission officially designated ChatGPT as a Very Large Online Search Engine (VLOSE) and classified Reddit and Roblox as Very Large Online Platforms (VLOPs) under the Digital Services Act.

intelligence_read: Efforts to verify and govern automated web traffic reached key milestones with the IETF Web Bot Auth Working Group adopting an official HTTP message signatures draft and Cloudflare optimizing edge verification performance. In parallel, Apple formally decoupled AI crawler opt-outs from search visibility, while the European Commission expanded search engine oversight by designating ChatGPT as a Very Large Online Search Engine under the Digital Services Act.
